text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the trainer's office for 
the meeting, Buena Vista was softly 
snoring away.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! It's already time for the 
meeting, right?
choice_data_list: You didn't get much rest yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... while cleaning my room, I 
happened to find an old photo album.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Big bro—I mean, Trainer, I got caught up 
reminiscing about old times with you and 
stayed up late... I'm sorry."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I was reminiscing about the old days with 
my big si... I mean, with you, Trainer, 
and ended up staying up late... I'm so 
sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Immersing herself too deeply in memories 
of bygone days, it seems she wasn't able 
to rest well...
